create_RMSNorm: create an RMSNorm layer with given width and epsilon for normalizing activations
build_RGLRU_layer: build a Real-Gated Linear Recurrent Unit layer with specified width and number of heads
run_rnn_scan: run the linear RNN scan recurrence with input, diagonal matrix A, reset flags, and initial hidden state
create_Conv1D_layer: create a 1D temporal convolution layer with given width and temporal receptive field size
create_Einsum_layer: create an einsum-based tensor multiplication layer with custom equation, weights, and bias
